reviews.title: Great processor
reviews.comment:
Since this is not the unlocked version, it comes with a stock cpu fan. However, when running using that fan it would run hot when all the cores were running at full load, hitting up to 90ºC at the peak.
However, changing the stock cpu fan for a better one solved the issue and now it run stably at full load and no hotter than 70ºC.

reviews.title: quality.  Terrible intel cpu cooler. To short of a 4 pin power connection
reviews.comment: I like this processor, but it is locked low power version. One more thing I know now my Corsair cooler went out. Back for return. The fan to this processor is that the power cable from the cpu cool is so damn short.  I can’t plug it in no matter which way I switch it.  Plan on buying a cooler for this cpu. Or you can maybe buy an extension 4 pin cable.  But it is useless for me as it is now
